pages.quiz:
HOME SCIENCE MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

8. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Meals for Special Occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Meals for Special Occasions.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Meals for Special Occasions.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Meals for Special Occasions.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meals for Special Occasions.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Special Treatment in Laundry Work? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Special Treatment in Laundry Work.

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Yeast Products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Yeast Products.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Yeast Products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Yeast Products.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Yeast Products.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer Protection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Special Treatment in Laundry Work and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Glucose and oxygen

2. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection.

3. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.

4. B — 100 °C

5. A — newton (N)

6. A — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

7. C — Ice melting to water

8. B — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

9. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meals for Special Occasions.

10. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Special Treatment in Laundry Work.

11. C — Producers

12. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Yeast Products.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Consumer Protection; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Special Treatment in Laundry Work; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
